name: openspec_usage
description: Deterministic decision step, replacing a JSON_JQ_TRANSFORM.

assessment.description: Usage report contributing tokenUsed/costUsd (e.g. from an assessment agent run). Non-dict values are treated as {}.

child.description: Usage report contributing totalTokens/totalCostUsd (e.g. aggregated child workflow usage). Non-dict values are treated as {}.

verification.description: Usage report contributing tokenUsed/costUsd (e.g. from semantic verification). Non-dict values are treated as {}.

totalTokens.description: Sum of assessment.tokenUsed, child.totalTokens, and verification.tokenUsed (missing/non-numeric fields treated as 0).

totalCostUsd.description: Sum of assessment.costUsd, child.totalCostUsd, and verification.costUsd (missing/non-numeric fields treated as 0).
